covers: Contracts 7 quoting (comma, quote, ; and | in fields, multiline inside quotes)
Contracts 7 list escaping (backslash-; and backslash-| inside names)
notes: The file has 3 physical lines after the header but 2 records, because record 2 has a newline inside a quoted field. Whitespace around list separators is trimmed. Escapes apply only in list fields (chunks, subtasks); the what field is plain text, so its ; and | stay literal.
